jd_text: A well-established education group in Saudi Arabia is seeking a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to provide strategic technology leadership across both higher education and K-12 environments in Riyadh. Reporting to senior leadership and the Board, the CTO will be responsible for defining and executing enterprise-wide IT strategy, leading digital transformation initiatives, and ensuring secure, scalable, and future-ready technology platforms that support teaching, learning, and operations, in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030 . Key Responsibilities Develop and deliver a comprehensive IT and digital transformation strategy Lead the selection, implementation, and integration of SIS, LMS, CRM, and ERP systems Define enterprise architecture and drive a cloud-first approach Oversee cybersecurity, data governance, and regulatory compliance Ensure reliable IT operations, service management, and business continuity Build, lead, and develop high-performing technology teams Partner with academic leaders, administrators, and external stakeholders Candidate Profile Must be a Saudi National 15+ years of IT experience, including senior leadership roles (CTO, CIO, IT Director) Strong background within the education sector Proven expertise in enterprise architecture, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, and data governance Track record of delivering large-scale digital transformation programmes Experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider Middle East preferred Fluent in English; Arabic language skills highly advantageous
